newsitem.title: FRANCE: OECD says CIS accounting standards to be drawn up.
newsitem.headline: OECD says CIS accounting standards to be drawn up.

text.p: The OECD said on Thursday a series of internationally-harmonised accounting standards and reporting rules would be drawn up for the Commonwealth of Independent States and Mongolia.
"A long term undertaking, the project also involves the International Accounting standards Committee," the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development said in a statement.
It said the agreement to draw up the framework followed a meeting of the Coordinating Council on Accounting Methodology in the CIC (CCAM).
"It will constitute a major step forward in harmonising accounting practice within the CIS and achieving adherence to international standards," said the statement.
"Experts will review initial drafts in 1997," it added.
